paragraphs.text: The Unyaro Plains (un-yah-roh ) stretched north–south at the west coast of Zhalfir , bordering the delta surrounding Ki'pamu and Kiingal .

Although there were small Zhalfirin towns and villages on the plains, there were no major settlements on this region. The plains were known for their widespread wildlife, including predatory griffins and swarms of deadly bees.
East of the Unyaro Plains, lies the Unyaro Jungle , which surrounds Ki'pamu.

The Unyaro Plains and Jungle were phased out, alongside the rest of northwestern Jamuraa , by Teferi to spare it from the horrors of the Phyrexian Invasion . It was forever lost from Dominaria after Jeska destroyed the time rift over the Zhalfirin Void.

After the New Phyrexian Invasion , Wrenn and Realmbreaker returned the phased out Zhalfir to the multiverse by switching the landmass' place with that of New Phyrexia . The plains and jungle now exist as part of the plane of Zhalfir.
Unyaro is said to derive from a word or name meaning "foot", relating to its position and flatness.
